title: AccelStack: A Cost-Driven Analysis of 3D-Stacked LLM Accelerators
problem: LLM accelerators face high bandwidth and latency demands despite HBM and 2.5D packaging; 3D stacking offers new opportunities but cost tradeoffs are unclear.
motivation: Understanding cost-performance tradeoffs of 3D-stacked architectures enables practical accelerator designs with optimal PPA for different deployment scenarios.
method: AccelStack models memory-on-logic performance and die-stacking costs (DoD, DoW, WoW). Evaluates 3D designs against NVIDIA A100/H100 across LLM workloads.
key_novelty: Cost-driven analysis framework for 3D-stacked LLM accelerators comparing different die-stacking modalities.
contributions: Performance model capturing memory-on-logic behavior in 3D stacks
Cost models for die-on-die, die-on-wafer, wafer-on-wafer stacking
7.17x speedup vs. A100 (FP16), 2.09x vs. H100 (FP8) across LLM workloads
38.09% cost reduction via chiplet designs vs. monolithic implementations
limitations: Simulation-based evaluation; actual silicon and chiplet integration challenges not addressed.
